alt: 棋手的國王倒下，己方棋子幾乎全被吃光，對手的棋子仍完整站在棋盤上，敗局已無法挽回。
scene_prompt: 一敗塗地 means a crushing total defeat with no way to recover. Modern friendly chess club. A teenager sits at a wooden chessboard, defeated and astonished: his pale king has toppled, nearly all his pale pieces are captured in a small pile beside him, while the opponent's dark pieces still dominate the board in a strong orderly formation. Opponent remains polite, no taunting or celebration over distress. Board and fallen king are the clear focal point, normal chess pieces but no letters, notation or brand marks. No injury, war imagery or destruction; visual overwhelming game defeat.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper.
